correctionMatrixV2C1ToC10.name: worktree-root confinement
correctionMatrixV2C1ToC10.evidence: External non-git cwd fails closed (exit 2, nothing created). NOTE: create binds to the CURRENT worktree, not the worktree containing the factory script — a foreign valid Git worktree receives the write (see probe A).

correctionMatrixV2C1ToC10.name: strict name-status source+destination
correctionMatrixV2C1ToC10.evidence: A/M/D/T and R/C parsed with both paths; malformed/unknown/wrong-arity rejected. NOTE: similarity scores are not bounded to 0-100 (R101/C999 accepted — probe K).

correctionMatrixV2C1ToC10.name: trusted PR/change-mode identity
correctionMatrixV2C1ToC10.evidence: Mode requires trusted branch metadata; factory-without-metadata and research-branch-touching-factory rejected. NOTE: factory lineage is a broad prefix regex that admits spoof branches (probe B).

correctionMatrixV2C1ToC10.name: exact factory workflow allowlist
correctionMatrixV2C1ToC10.evidence: Unrelated workflow CHANGES rejected; exact factory workflow accepted. NOTE: deletion of the factory workflow and mutation of frozen factory records under factory-governance are accepted (probes D/N).

correctionMatrixV2C1ToC10.name: stage-aware append-only
correctionMatrixV2C1ToC10.evidence: Closed-stage M/D/R rejected; transitions validated from Git blobs. NOTE: initial creation admits arbitrary payload (not the exact skeleton) and per-stage additions are not inventory-exact (probes E/F).

correctionMatrixV2C1ToC10.name: GITHUB_PLAN cross-binding
correctionMatrixV2C1ToC10.evidence: TASK_STATE.branch==taskBranch==pullRequest.head and base=main enforced internally. NOTE: the trusted PR head branch is not bound to the task's declared branch (probe C).

correctionMatrixV2C1ToC10.name: identity grammar/types
correctionMatrixV2C1ToC10.evidence: country/exchange/batch/priority/branch grammar enforced at create and validate; malformed-but-equal rejected (fixtures V2-C7..e).

correctionMatrixV2C1ToC10.name: nine research JSON structures
correctionMatrixV2C1ToC10.evidence: Object top level + governed collection/object required for all nine; arrays/null/primitives rejected. NOTE: vacuous empty {} objects for overallFinding/review/readiness and primitive entries in non-ID collections are accepted (probe L).

correctionMatrixV2C1ToC10.name: strict UTF-8
correctionMatrixV2C1ToC10.evidence: Fatal decode rejects overlong/lone-continuation/surrogate/truncated bytes on all eleven files; BOM/CR rejected. NOTE: NUL and other C0 control bytes (valid UTF-8) are not rejected as non-canonical text (probe M).

correctionMatrixV2C1ToC10.name: identity-bound cumulative markers
correctionMatrixV2C1ToC10.evidence: Markers must be regular, canonical, parseable, task-ID-bound; zero-byte/malformed/wrong-task/non-cumulative rejected. NOTE: outcome/state/mergeCommit fields accept ARBITRARY non-empty values (no enum, no 40-hex merge identity, no receipt linkage); cumulative correction history not enforced (probes G/H).

newProbeMatrixAtoN.evidence: CBW CLI invoked by absolute path with cwd inside a DIFFERENT valid Git repo created <foreign>/research-ops/tasks/CBW-KZ-BINANCE-P0-D-DEEP-RESEARCH-001 (exit 0). resolveWorktreeRoot resolves the CURRENT worktree, not the worktree containing the factory script — a reproducible foreign-worktree write.

newProbeMatrixAtoN.evidence: trustedModeFromMeta grants FACTORY_GOVERNANCE to feat/researchops-factory-v1-1-evil, correction/researchops-factory-v1-1-unrelated and validation/researchops-factory-v1-1-fake — a broad prefix regex, not an exact approved task/PR lineage.

newProbeMatrixAtoN.name: research branch mismatch
newProbeMatrixAtoN.evidence: Boundary accepts a research-task PR with trusted head 'research/zz-fake-b' regardless of the changed task's declared TASK_STATE.branch/GITHUB_PLAN.taskBranch/pullRequest.head; no head<->task-branch binding exists in the boundary.

newProbeMatrixAtoN.name: factory governance record immutability
newProbeMatrixAtoN.evidence: Under a trusted factory branch, M of validation-009/**, correction-010/**, correction-validation-011/**, governance/** and correction-v2-012 CONTRACT are all accepted (ok=true), and D of the factory workflow is accepted. The broad research-ops/factory-v1-1/** allowlist permits mutation/deletion of frozen governance/history layers.

newProbeMatrixAtoN.name: initial task exact skeleton
newProbeMatrixAtoN.evidence: checkStageTransition creation admits any all-addition set under one root (00-contract + 10-input/arbitrary.bin + 70-validation/EVIL.json + ROGUE.txt accepted). Creation is create-only, not verified equal to the deterministic factory skeleton.

newProbeMatrixAtoN.name: exact per-stage inventory / conflicting markers
newProbeMatrixAtoN.evidence: validateMarker returns on the FIRST existing anyOf candidate: a valid 70-validation/VALIDATION.json hides a conflicting wrong-task FACTORY_VALIDATION.json (markerOk=true). Per-stage additions are not inventory-exact.

newProbeMatrixAtoN.name: marker outcome semantics
newProbeMatrixAtoN.evidence: A validation marker with validationOutcome:'banana' is accepted; a merge marker with mergeCommit:'x' is accepted. No recognized-enum check, no 40-hex commit identity, no target-main, no preceding-receipt linkage for RESEARCH_RECORD_MERGED_TO_MAIN.

newProbeMatrixAtoN.name: cumulative correction history
newProbeMatrixAtoN.evidence: A task whose TASK_STATE.history shows CORRECTION_REQUIRED/CORRECTED reaches VALIDATED with NO 60-correction marker and still validates (ok=true); the correction marker is not retained/required.

newProbeMatrixAtoN.name: TASK_STATE history integrity
newProbeMatrixAtoN.evidence: TASK_STATE with state=VALIDATED but history=[{state:PREPARED}] validates (ok=true); validateTaskStateShape emits no history-integrity error. Head/last-entry agreement, canonical in-history transitions and no-rewrite are not enforced.

newProbeMatrixAtoN.name: stage transition edge cases
newProbeMatrixAtoN.evidence: Root-level non-state additions rejected, root-deletion-via-rename rejected, missing-base-blob non-PREPARED rejected, copy-in-open-stage allowed. NOTE: 20-research-output remains writable on a PACKAGE_VALIDATED same-state append (arguably should be immutable after capture).

newProbeMatrixAtoN.name: strict Git name-status grammar
newProbeMatrixAtoN.evidence: parseNameStatus score regex \d{1,3} accepts out-of-range similarity scores R101 and C999 (Git range is 0-100); quoted/escaped path forms are not explicitly handled.

newProbeMatrixAtoN.name: package structural minima
newProbeMatrixAtoN.evidence: Empty {} objects for overallFinding/review/readiness are accepted (vacuous minima); primitive entries in the non-ID 'notes' collection (notes:[5,'x']) are accepted.

newProbeMatrixAtoN.name: UTF-8 and canonical text edge cases
newProbeMatrixAtoN.evidence: Fatal decode correctly rejects overlong/lone-continuation/surrogate/truncated sequences and BOM/CR, but NUL (0x00) and other C0 control bytes are valid UTF-8 and are NOT rejected as non-canonical package text.

newProbeMatrixAtoN.name: workflow and metadata integrity
newProbeMatrixAtoN.evidence: Actual PR #53 factory workflow run 30257622173 on d3ed112 succeeded read-only. Positive handling correct (empty diff->1, multi-root->1). But deletion of the factory workflow and mutation of a frozen factory record under a trusted factory PR are both accepted (ties to D).

workflowValidation.judgment: The workflow is read-only and fail-closed at discovery and passes trusted metadata, but it delegates to a boundary whose factory-governance allowlist is too broad and whose stage/marker/history checks are incomplete; a green run is not sufficient evidence.

authorizationValidation.note: All corrections-required findings are confinement/boundary/validation-completeness gaps, not privilege escalations. No probe could authorize master/canonical/production/deploy/Binance/merge.

correctionRequiredFindings.summary: Foreign-worktree write: create binds to the current worktree, not the factory script's worktree, and writes into a different valid Git repo.

Frozen governance/history records (validation-009, correction-010, correction-validation-011, governance, correction-v2-012 contract) and the factory workflow are mutable/deletable under factory-governance.
Broad factory-branch prefix regex grants FACTORY_GOVERNANCE to spoofed lineage branches.
TASK_STATE.history integrity unenforced: head state may contradict history; no canonical-in-history or no-rewrite checks.
Marker outcome/merge semantics accept arbitrary non-empty values; no recognized enum, 40-hex merge identity, target-main or receipt linkage.
Trusted research head branch is not bound to the task's declared branch/plan.
Initial creation admits arbitrary payload; not verified equal to the deterministic factory skeleton.
Per-stage inventory not exact; a valid marker hides a conflicting invalid duplicate candidate.
Cumulative correction history not enforced: VALIDATED after CORRECTED omits the correction marker.
Vacuous empty {} top-level objects and primitive non-ID collection entries accepted.
Git similarity scores outside 0-100 (R101/C999) accepted; quoted-path forms unhandled.
NUL and C0 control bytes not rejected as non-canonical package text.

nonblockingNotes: Correction V2 genuinely closed the ten Validation-011 findings (A–K); the 108 fixtures and the read-only PR #53 workflow run are green. The A–N probes are deeper, mostly NEW adversarial surfaces.
J: 20-research-output remains writable on a PACKAGE_VALIDATED same-state append; consider making captured output immutable from RESEARCH_CAPTURED onward.
Authorization floor is intact: owner-receipt privilege escalation rejected, all authorization fixtures green.
Local main/master tracking branches are ahead of origin from unrelated local work; origin control-plane SHAs match the frozen lineage and were not modified by this task.
requiredCorrections: A: Bind create output to the worktree that contains the factory script (or fail closed when the script worktree and current worktree differ); resolve through symlinked script paths and linked worktrees.
B: Replace the factory-branch prefix regex with an exact approved task/PR lineage allowlist.
C: Bind the trusted PR head branch to the changed task's TASK_STATE.branch / GITHUB_PLAN.taskBranch / pullRequest.head.

D: Freeze governance/validation/correction/history layers and the factory workflow against mutation/deletion; restrict factory-governance to the current task's authorized implementation paths and new result files only; reject factory-file deletions.
E: Require an initial creation PR to equal the deterministic factory skeleton exactly (exact contract file set; no arbitrary payload).
F: Enforce exact per-stage inventories and reject conflicting duplicate marker candidates.
G: Require recognized outcome enums, exact identity/lineage, and for RESEARCH_RECORD_MERGED_TO_MAIN a real 40-hex main merge commit with preceding-receipt linkage.
H: Make higher-stage evidence retain the correction marker when history contains CORRECTION_REQUIRED/CORRECTED.
I: Enforce TASK_STATE.history integrity: head==last entry, canonical in-history transitions, well-typed identities/timestamps, no rewrite of prior history.
K: Bound Git similarity scores to 0-100 and handle/reject quoted/escaped name-status paths.
L: Reject vacuous empty {} top-level objects and primitive collection entries.
M: Reject NUL and C0 control bytes as non-canonical package text.
